CodexLogin.description:

while `pending`, only to the token that started it.
CodexLogin.title: CodexLogin

CredentialUpdate.description: E.g. refreshed OAuth tokens for a subscription account.
CredentialUpdate.title: CredentialUpdate

Criteria.description: Deterministic acceptance checks for a local answer.
Criteria.title: Criteria

Fact.description: One readiness fact: true, false, or unknown (None) with its evidence.

KnowledgeRef.description: A pointer delivered with a claim or a search: enough to decide whether to read.
KnowledgeRef.title: KnowledgeRef

KnowledgeWrite.description: Result of a create/edit: published directly, or proposed for review.
KnowledgeWrite.title: KnowledgeWrite

LocalModelInfo.description: Measured from the server, never configured.

TaskResult-Output.description: The one result envelope every task completes with (3.11).
TaskResult-Output.title: TaskResult

Usage-Input.description: What the work cost, as reported by the agent. Recorded, never enforced.
Usage-Input.title: Usage

UsageReport.description: One engine run on one held account (account usage 3.2).
UsageReport.title: UsageReport

schema.title: Response List Accounts Api Accounts Get

post.description:
Register an account. A `credential` is written to the SOPS file first
(as `account-<id>`); the registry row only ever holds the reference.

Start the official client's `setup-token` login for a new `anthropic`
account, or to renew `renew_account_id` (claude accounts spec 3).
Hand the sign-in page's code to the waiting client, once.

Start the official client's device-code login for a new `openai` account
(codex accounts spec 3). On success the account appears in the registry.

Lease the best usable account among `providers` (most preferred first),
with its credential. One active lease per role; it ends when released or
replaced.
`409 no_account` when none is usable.
End the agent's leases: one `role`, or all of them.

get.description:
Reported tokens per account over [from, to), bucketed in the viewer's
timezone (account usage 3.5). Buckets with no rows are measured zeros.

put.description:
Replace the credential (e.g. refreshed OAuth tokens). Allowed for the agent
holding a lease on the account, or an admin. If it cannot be persisted, the
account is disabled rather than left with a token that would be lost.

post.description:
Report that the leased account hit a quota. Returns the next account to use
(same provider first), or none: then the given task is blocked as
`no_account` and returns to ready when an account frees up.

Read the provider's quota now (Codex only; account usage 3.3). At most once
per account per 5 minutes; never refreshes the credential.

Re-read the SOPS file after editing it by hand (`sops secrets.sops.yaml`),
then re-check every account's secret reference.

schema.title: Response List Admin Tokens Api Admin Tokens Get

post.description: Mint another admin token. The secret is shown only in this response.

schema.title: Response List Agents Api Agents Get

post.description: Mint a one-time token an agent redeems at registration.
Prove liveness and renew the listed task leases (each one independently).
Exit cleanly: the identity ends and its token is revoked.
Let the agent finish its current work, then claim nothing new.

get.description: The inbox: open decisions by default, oldest first.

schema.title: Response List Decisions Api Decisions Get

post.description:
Answer an open decision. Approvals take `approve`/`reject`, reviews
`accept`/`reject` (with `text` as notes), questions their options or text.

get.description:
Engines, executors and the local model: axes, auth methods and the three
readiness facts (installed, authenticated, validated). Read-only.

post.description:
One bounded completion on the local model, checked against `criteria`.
No tools act, so retrying or escalating duplicates no effect. An answer that
fails the criteria returns `verdict: escalate`; Argus does not start the
escalated work, the caller does.
Where should this task run? Deterministic; the decision is recorded.

A worker's channel switched its harness to follow a leased account
(codex accounts spec 3). Recorded for the audit trail; credentials never ride here.

get.description: Event history, newest first. Page backwards with `before`.

schema.title: Response List Events Api Events Get

get.description: Server-sent events. Reconnect with `Last-Event-ID` to resume without gaps.
What this node can run right now, measured from its targets (read-only).

The worker templates Argus supports, per node: ready, or exactly what is
missing. Read-only; nothing is created by looking.

post.description:
Create a pool from a template and request its first workers, in one
confirmed call. The pool is rebuilt server-side from the template; refusals
happen before anything is written. Success means *requested*.

schema.title: Response List Instances Api Instances Get

get.description: The container's recent output, read live from the target (not stored).

post.description:
Stop an instance now: its agents end immediately (tasks released); its slot
frees once the provider confirms the container is gone.

schema.title: Response List Pages Api Knowledge Pages Get

post.description:
Create a page. Workers may be limited to proposing (see
ARGUS_KNOWLEDGE_WORKER_WRITES); the response says which happened.
Confirm the page is still right; resets its freshness.

schema.title: Response List Revisions Api Knowledge Pages  Page Id  Revisions Get

post.description:
Publish an edit. `base_revision_id` must be the page's current revision,
otherwise `409 knowledge_conflict`: re-read the page and apply the change again.

get.description: Proposals are resolved by answering their `knowledge` decision.

schema.title: Response List Proposals Api Knowledge Proposals Get

get.description:
Full-text search over active pages (all words must match; if nothing does,
any word may). Stale pages rank after fresh ones.

schema.title: Response Search Api Knowledge Search Get

get.description: Prometheus text format; needs an admin token (`authorization` in the scrape config).
Fleet-wide totals per state for the Home view (orchestrator or admin).

schema.title: Response List Pools Api Pools Get

put.description:
Create or replace a pool definition, including its replica cap (admin only).
The reconciler converges instances to it within seconds.

post.description:
Request one more worker from the pool. Refused (nothing changes) when the
node cannot start it now. Success means *requested*: the reconciler starts
the instance next pass; follow it in `/instances`.

Set desired replicas. Orchestrators may scale up to `max_replicas`; asking
for more opens a decision for a human (`decision_id`) instead of failing.

schema.title: Response List Projects Api Projects Get

get.description: Readiness plus the numbers /metrics reports, as JSON for the dashboard.

schema.title: Response List Kinds Api Task Kinds Get

put.description:
Create or replace a kind. Existing tasks keep the values they were created
with; schemas apply to new tasks and to results submitted from now on.

schema.title: Response List Tasks Api Tasks Get

post.description:
Orchestrators and admins create any task; workers only subtasks of a task
they hold. Past the per-agent hourly limit, an agent's new tasks wait for
human approval (a `policy` decision) instead of being refused.
Claim a ready task, long-polling up to `wait_s` seconds for one.

204.description: No matching task became ready within wait_s

schema.title: Response List Artifacts Api Tasks  Task Id  Artifacts Get

post.description:
Upload the raw request body as an artifact of the attempt you hold.

List the returned id in `result.artifacts` when completing the task.

Ask a question about the task you hold. The task is blocked until it is
answered; the answer is added to the task spec under "Clarifications" and
the task returns to ready.
Post a progress note (at most one per 10 s). Also renews the lease.
Return a `failed` task to `ready` with a fresh window of attempts (409 otherwise).
